worldcombat.skill.powertrip.summary: Put every stat stage you carry into a swaggering charge straight at the chosen foe: the more positive stages you hold, the further and faster you rush, the heavier the blow and the further you shove them. The stages stay on you, so you can keep charging; the cost is that you only commit to the one target in front of you (the drive form carries through to a second).
worldcombat.skill.powertrip.use.0: Stack stages, then charge in for a heavy blow
worldcombat.skill.powertrip.use.1: Shove one target a long way
worldcombat.skill.powertrip.use.2: Plough through two targets with the drive form
Each target hit takes %1$s contact damage; every positive stage among your five stats adds to it, currently %2$s stages of swagger.
Charges %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick, with a %3$s block hit radius, and shoves the target %4$s blocks.
It can reach up to %1$s targets.
worldcombat.skill.powertrip.drive.on: Drive form: the charge carries through, reaching up to two targets (x0.88 each), at weaker shove, +3 recovery and +5 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.powertrip.drive.off: Pin form: stop on the first target, x1.1 on the single blow, stronger shove and a faster rhythm.
worldcombat.skill.powertrip.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s committed cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.powertrip.growth.0: From level %1$s: rush power %2$s, charge distance %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.powertrip.growth.1: From level %1$s: rush power %2$s, distance %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.powertrip.preference.d: On (drive): the charge carries through, reaching up to two targets (x0.88 each), at a weaker shove, +3 recovery and +5 cooldown - made for ploughing into a crowd. Off (pin): stop on the first target, x1.1 on the single blow, a stronger shove and a faster rhythm.
worldcombat.skill.powertrip.preference.a: Within this distance it is willing to open with the charge; beyond it the priority drops low (the shared approach still walks it in). It is a contact move, so a larger value only starts it a little sooner.
On: each positive stage raises the priority further, so a banked swagger is more willingly spent on a charge. Off: ignore the swagger and rank it as an ordinary close-range attack.
